source: Your pottery collection appointment is booked for Wednesday, November 4, at 3:30 p.m. Come to the front entrance on Alder Street and show the attendant your booking email. The pieces will be wrapped, but please bring a box for carrying them home. If someone else collects for you, forward this email to them first.
objective: Update the appointment to Thursday, November 5, at 11:15 a.m., and change the collection entrance to the side door on Pine Lane. Keep the other instructions.
